profile.description: County fair and 4-H prospect centered on Ramsey County 4-H Achievement Days. The Devils Lake fairgrounds offers a 4-H Hall, outdoor arena, and a newer multipurpose event center with vendor electrical hookups, supporting family-focused public programming. Verified 2026 Achievement Days were June 17–19; 2027 dates and application timing were not published as of August 31, 2026.

notes.subject: 2027 prospect research — reviewed August 31, 2026
notes.body: Official Ramsey County Fairgrounds information confirms a family-driven mission, the venue at 7823 Hwy 19 W in Devils Lake, and facilities including the 4-H Hall, Peterson Arena, and Western State Bank Event Center with electrical hookups for vendors. Connie Hanson is listed on the fair board. NDSU published June 17–19 for the 2026 Ramsey County 4-H Achievement Days. No official 2027 fair dates or vendor/entertainment opening were found. Sources: https://www.ramseycountyfairgrounds.com/ and https://www.ndsu.edu/agriculture/extension/events/ramsey-county-4-h-achievement-days

notes.body:
Subject: Ramsey County Fair — early 2027 Adventure Zone planning

Hi Connie,

It was great meeting you through the HAFFE convention. I have been looking at Ramsey County Fair’s growth around the multipurpose event center and the expanded public programming alongside the 4-H activities, and I wanted to reach out early as you begin planning for 2027.

The Adventure Zone brings a fully staffed inflatable bounce house carnival, with setup, operation, and teardown included. We can discuss a prepaid package or, where appropriate, a pay-for-play arrangement. Would you be open to a short conversation once your 2027 dates and entertainment plans begin taking shape?

Best,
Desiree
The Adventure Zone
America’s Best Inflatable Bounce House Carnival
